title: Connect every completed path to exact implementation
statement: As a reviewer, I can traverse from an accepted criterion through each required Product, Design, Quality, and Implementation artifact to exact current diffs, and traverse the same graph in reverse.

acceptance_criteria.statement: Exact embedded-deck diff evidence is owned only by Items and uses canonical current line or file-event diff URIs.

A complete path requires a current accepted criterion revision, current typed relations and content digests, validated containment where used, existing terminal resources, and exact evidence matching the active source comparison.
Queries return criterion-to-diff paths and reverse lookup by exact diff URI or committed source-head identity.
One artifact may address several criteria, one criterion may have several artifacts, and shared diff selectors remain explicit per path rather than being arbitrarily assigned.
Multiple semantic heads, invalid selectors, missing endpoints, broad containment, and stale source identities are reported as distinct diagnostics.
Trace completeness and global all-atoms-mapped coverage remain separate omission checks and never claim that the implementation is correct.
Implementation contains one or more focused slide decks whose Items link directly to stories or criteria, relevant design resources, and exact diffs.
Every artifact counted as complete reaches at least one exact current implementation or test diff, or carries a current explicit exclusion for that coverage axis.
